{"test_name":"Ledger_2283_Objection3","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedClosedGenericValueType_FromReferencedAssembly_GeneratesResolverWithoutCrashing()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib;\n\npublic class OuterClass<TOuter>\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial record struct InnerRecordStruct<TInner>([property: Key(0)] TOuter OuterValue, [property: Key(1)] TInner InnerValue);\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial struct InnerStruct<TInner>\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public TInner Value { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\npublic partial struct OuterStruct<TOuter>\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial record struct InnerRecordStruct<TInner>([property: Key(0)] TOuter OuterValue, [property: Key(1)] TInner InnerValue);\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing Lib;\n\nnamespace App;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n{\n    [Key(1)]\n    public OuterClass<int>.InnerRecordStruct<string> Member1 { get; init; }\n\n    [Key(2)]\n    public OuterClass<int>.InnerStruct<string> Member2 { get; init; }\n\n    [Key(3)]\n    public OuterStruct<int>.InnerRecordStruct<string> Member3 { get; init; }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = await GetBaseReferencesAsync();\n        MetadataReference libReference = BuildAssemblyReference(\"Lib\", libSource, baseReferences, runGenerator: true);\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            baseReferences.Add(libReference),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.NotEmpty(runResult.Results);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(runResult.Diagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning);\n\n        var generatedSources = runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources).ToArray();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedSources);\n        Assert.Contains(generatedSources, s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedClosedGenericValueType_WithDiagnosticTriggeringMetadataMembers_DoesNotCrashOrReportInvalidLocation()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace LibDiag;\n\npublic class OuterWithDiagnostics<TOuter>\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial struct InnerWithUnkeyedAndNullKey<TInner>\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public TOuter OuterValue { get; set; }\n\n        [Key((string)null!)]\n        public TInner NullKeyValue { get; set; }\n\n        public int UnkeyedProperty { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing LibDiag;\n\nnamespace AppDiag;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic sealed partial class Holder\n{\n    [Key(0)]\n    public OuterWithDiagnostics<int>.InnerWithUnkeyedAndNullKey<string> Member { get; set; }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = await GetBaseReferencesAsync();\n        MetadataReference libReference = BuildAssemblyReference(\"LibDiag\", libSource, baseReferences, runGenerator: false);\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"AppDiag\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            baseReferences.Add(libReference),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.NotEmpty(runResult.Results);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\");\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(runResult.Diagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\");\n\n        var generatedSources = runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources).ToArray();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedSources);\n        Assert.Contains(generatedSources, s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.All(analyzerDiagnostics, d =>\n        {\n            Assert.True(d.Location.IsInSource);\n            Assert.True(appCompilation.ContainsSyntaxTree(d.Location.SourceTree));\n        });\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d =>\n            d.GetMessage().Contains(\"UnkeyedProperty\", StringComparison.Ordinal) ||\n            d.GetMessage().Contains(\"NullKeyValue\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<ImmutableArray<MetadataReference>> GetBaseReferencesAsync()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        return net80Refs.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n    }\n\n    private static MetadataReference BuildAssemblyReference(string assemblyName, string source, ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references, bool runGenerator)\n    {\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            assemblyName,\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        Compilation compilationToEmit = compilation;\n        if (runGenerator)\n        {\n            GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n            driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out compilationToEmit, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n            GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n            Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n            Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        }\n\n        using var peStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var emitResult = compilationToEmit.Emit(peStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        return MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(peStream.ToArray());\n    }\n}\n"}
